variants.name: Current architecture
variants.summary: System level: the running applications and storage behind archboard. Current source as inspected 2026-09-13; drill into each application for its internal modules.

nodes.name: Agent CLI
nodes.responsibility: Authors named boards: one short-lived process per command, writing nothing itself
nodes.description: Every stated change reaches the canvas over HTTP. The one command that draws for itself is rasterize, which takes the SVG the canvas made into a headless browser here.

nodes.name: Canvas server
nodes.responsibility: Owns every board, draws every view, and answers both applications
nodes.description: One process. Board persistence, the renderer, the pane sockets and the agent workbench all live in it; the Codex app-server is its private child.

nodes.name: Browser
nodes.responsibility: Reads architecture; owns the camera, the view, the walkthrough and the selection, and nothing else

nodes.name: Board vault
nodes.responsibility: One document per board, holding every variant of it
nodes.description: Tracked in the repository. The file is the board and nothing holds a copy of it: an accepted write is on disk, fsync included, before it is answered (ADR 0015, ADR 0023).

nodes.name: Codex app-server
nodes.responsibility: Runs the linked agent threads, as one private child of the canvas
nodes.description: Its own storage, its own process group, spoken to over stdio. Archboard's side of it is the agent workbench inside the canvas server.

nodes.name: Repository checkout
nodes.responsibility: The source a node's binding resolves to on this machine
nodes.description: A binding names a repository identity and a path inside it, which are the same in every clone; a machine-local registry is the only place a directory on one machine is written down.

nodes.name: Skill evaluation
nodes.responsibility: Measures one version of the agent skill against another, on real authors and real checkouts
nodes.description: Started by a person, never by the gate: every author run and the grading session call a model.

nodes.name: Headless Chromium
nodes.responsibility: Paints an SVG and answers with the bitmap, when a command asks for a picture

edges.label: one per run, on its own port

beats.heading: Agents author, people read
beats.body: An agent states meaning through the CLI. The canvas checks the write, takes the board's lease, commits the whole family to disk and only then answers. Nothing else writes a board.

beats.heading: The browser is a viewer
beats.body: A pane holds board content only as a read-only cache of what the server said, and reads again when it is told a new version exists. What it owns is the camera, the view, the walkthrough position and what somebody picked out.

beats.heading: Agent work has a lifetime of its own
beats.body: The canvas owns a private Codex child with its own storage and process group. A pane's thread link names one workhorse; the child's exit invalidates it rather than leaving it dangling.

beats.heading: The skill is measured, not assumed
beats.body: The guidance an agent in another repository reads is held to real runs: two versions of the package, the same CLI and fixtures, real authors, and a blinded grading session. A person starts it; the gate never does.
